_readme: The evaluation set. Note the balance: only 4 of 12 cases are happy paths.
A golden set made of happy paths measures whether the demo still works.
The cases that matter are the ones where the correct behaviour is to refuse,
escalate, or return nothing -- because those are the behaviours that regress
silently. `kind` groups them; `must_not_call` and `forbidden_outcomes` are how
an unsafe trajectory fails even when the final answer looks acceptable.

why: Pins the DEFAULT, not a passed argument. Added after a deliberate
regression -- flipping dry_run's default to False -- passed the whole
suite. Every other refund case either passes dry_run explicitly or
fails on policy first, so nothing exercised the default. A safety
default no test pins is one refactor from disappearing.
